sources.summary: Proposed collection-page title, introductory copy, category descriptions, fabric claims, styling, care guidance, links and FAQs.

Live page title: 'Cotton Pants for Men | Buy Online at Cottonworld'; H1: 'Men's Pants'; 92 products shown. Navigation lists all, casual, regular fit, slim fit, drawstring, cargo, joggers, linen pants and 100% linen pants.
Cottonworld voice is calm, warm, plain and low-hype; avoid generic best/top claims and support factual fabric/product claims.
'mens pants online india' is mapped as a transactional per-category collection keyword.
